items.label: text
items.md: Raspberry Pi Pico has been designed to be a low cost yet flexible development platform for RP2040, with the following key features:
items.value: Raspberry Pi Pico has been designed to be a low cost yet flexible development platform for RP2040, with the following key features:

items.marker: Micro-USB B port for power and data (and for reprogramming the Flash)
items.value: Micro-USB B port for power and data (and for reprogramming the Flash)

items.marker: 40 pin 21 × 51 'DIP' style 1mm thick PCB with 0.1" through-hole pins also with edge castellations
items.value: 40 pin 21 × 51 'DIP' style 1mm thick PCB with 0.1" through-hole pins also with edge castellations

items.marker: 23 GPIO are digital-only and 3 are ADC capable
items.value: 23 GPIO are digital-only and 3 are ADC capable

items.marker: Can be surface mounted as a module
items.value: Can be surface mounted as a module

items.marker: Simple yet highly flexible power supply architecture
items.value: Simple yet highly flexible power supply architecture

items.marker: Various options for easily powering the unit from micro-USB, external supplies or batteries
items.value: Various options for easily powering the unit from micro-USB, external supplies or batteries

items.marker: High quality, low cost, high availability
items.value: High quality, low cost, high availability

items.marker: Comprehensive SDK, software examples and documentation
items.value: Comprehensive SDK, software examples and documentation

items.md:
- RP2040 microcontroller with 2MB Flash
- Micro-USB B port for power and data (and for reprogramming the Flash)
- 40 pin 21 × 51 'DIP' style 1mm thick PCB with 0.1" through-hole pins also with edge castellations
- Exposes 26 multi-function 3.3V General Purpose I/O (GPIO)
- 23 GPIO are digital-only and 3 are ADC capable
- Can be surface mounted as a module
- 3-pin ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) port
- Simple yet highly flexible power supply architecture
- Various options for easily powering the unit from micro-USB, external supplies or batteries
- High quality, low cost, high availability
- Comprehensive SDK, software examples and documentation
value: Micro-USB B port for power and data (and for reprogramming the Flash)

Can be surface mounted as a module
Simple yet highly flexible power supply architecture
Various options for easily powering the unit from micro-USB, external supplies or batteries
High quality, low cost, high availability
Comprehensive SDK, software examples and documentation

items.label: text
items.md: For full details of the RP2040 microcontroller please see the RP2040 Datasheet , however the headline features are:
items.value: For full details of the RP2040 microcontroller please see the RP2040 Datasheet , however the headline features are:

items.marker: Dual-core cortex M0+ at up to 133MHz
items.value: Dual-core cortex M0+ at up to 133MHz

items.marker: On-chip PLL allows variable core frequency
items.value: On-chip PLL allows variable core frequency

items.marker: External Quad-SPI Flash with eXecute In Place (XIP) and 16kB on-chip cache
items.value: External Quad-SPI Flash with eXecute In Place (XIP) and 16kB on-chip cache

items.md:
- Dual-core cortex M0+ at up to 133MHz
- On-chip PLL allows variable core frequency
- 264kB multi-bank high performance SRAM
- External Quad-SPI Flash with eXecute In Place (XIP) and 16kB on-chip cache
- High performance full-crossbar bus fabric

items.label: text
items.md: The physical pin numbering is shown in Figure 4, for the pin allocation see Figure 2 or the full Raspberry Pi Pico schematics in Appendix B.
items.value: The physical pin numbering is shown in Figure 4, for the pin allocation see Figure 2 or the full Raspberry Pi Pico schematics in Appendix B.

items.label: text
items.md: A few RP2040 GPIO pins are used for internal board functions, these are:
items.value: A few RP2040 GPIO pins are used for internal board functions, these are:

items.label: text
items.md: IP Used in ADC mode (ADC3) to measure VSYS/3
items.value: IP Used in ADC mode (ADC3) to measure VSYS/3

items.label: text
items.md: IP VBUS sense - high if VBUS is present, else low
items.value: IP VBUS sense - high if VBUS is present, else low

items.label: text
items.md: OP Controls the on-board SMPS Power Save pin (Section 4.4)
items.value: OP Controls the on-board SMPS Power Save pin (Section 4.4)

items.label: text
items.md: Apart from GPIO and ground pins, there are 7 other pins on the main 40-pin interface:
items.value: Apart from GPIO and ground pins, there are 7 other pins on the main 40-pin interface:

items.label: text
items.md: VBUS is the micro-USB input voltage, connected to micro-USB port pin 1. This is nominally 5V (or 0V if the USB is not connected or not powered).
items.value: VBUS is the micro-USB input voltage, connected to micro-USB port pin 1. This is nominally 5V (or 0V if the USB is not connected or not powered).

items.label: text
items.md: VSYS is the main system input voltage, which can vary in the allowed range 1.8V to 5.5V, and is used by the on-board SMPS to generate the 3.3V for the RP2040 and its GPIO.
items.value: VSYS is the main system input voltage, which can vary in the allowed range 1.8V to 5.5V, and is used by the on-board SMPS to generate the 3.3V for the RP2040 and its GPIO.

items.label: text
items.md: 3V3_EN connects to the on-board SMPS enable pin, and is pulled high (to VSYS) via a 100k Ω resistor. To disable the 3.3V (which also de-powers the RP2040), short this pin low.
items.value: 3V3_EN connects to the on-board SMPS enable pin, and is pulled high (to VSYS) via a 100k Ω resistor. To disable the 3.3V (which also de-powers the RP2040), short this pin low.

items.label: text
items.md: Operating conditions for the Raspberry Pi Pico are largely a function of the operating conditions specified by its components.
items.value: Operating conditions for the Raspberry Pi Pico are largely a function of the operating conditions specified by its components.

items.label: text
items.md: Note that VBUS and VSYS current will depend on use-case, some examples are given in the next section.
items.value: Note that VBUS and VSYS current will depend on use-case, some examples are given in the next section.

items.label: text
items.md: Recommended maximum ambient temperature of operation is 70°C.
items.value: Recommended maximum ambient temperature of operation is 70°C.
